description.value:
Partial Multi-Size Technique. The Akimichi clan converts calorie reserves directly into mass, enlarging one body part dramatically for a single attack.

Choose one limb. For the next Strike you make with that limb before the end of your next turn, the limb grows to Large size for the swing: the Strike increases its reach by 5 feet and its damage die by one step (d4 to d6, d6 to d8, d8 to d10, d10 to d12). On a hit, the target is also pushed back 5 feet.

The technique consumes a hearty meal worth of calories; you cannot recast it until you eat (a downtime activity, or by spending an action to consume rations).

Heightened (5th) The limb's effective size grows to Huge: reach increases by 10 feet and the damage die by two steps.

system.requirements: you have eaten in the last hour
